description: Send commandKey (a new 16–120 character letters/digits/underscore/hyphen key), owned threadId UUID, current integer sequence from get_doctor_conversation, and text. Optional responseStyle learning/technical/roast applies to this reply; omit for the account default. Optional doctorType fast/pro/elite picks the Fast, Pro or Elite Doctor; omit for the plan’s own Doctor. Returns the allowance quote and the chosen doctorType without starting a reply. Show the quote before requesting a start. Reuse its commandKey on every retry.

doctorType.description: Which Doctor answers this reply: fast = Fast Doctor (quick answers), pro = Pro Doctor (sharper reads for most questions, recommended), elite = Elite Doctor (the sharpest Doctor for the hardest slips). Omit for the plan's own Doctor. Free plans have the Fast Doctor only; a Doctor the plan does not include is refused with subscription_required, never swapped. Smarter Doctors take a little longer and use the plan faster.
